facts.fact: rtionline.gov.in covers Central Ministries/Departments and other Central public authorities only
facts.quote: No. This Portal is exclusively meant for Public Authorities under Central Govt. only.

facts.fact: The RTI application fee is Rs 10
facts.quote: An application under sub-section (1) of Section 6 of the Act shall be accompanied by a fee of rupees ten

facts.fact: BPL applicants pay no fee if they attach the BPL certificate issued by the appropriate government
facts.quote: No RTI fee is required to be paid by any citizen who is below poverty line as per RTI Rules, 2012. However, the applicant must attach a copy of the certificate issued by the appropriate government in this regard, alongwith the application.

facts.fact: Steps on RTI Online: click 'Submit Request', fill the form, then 'Make Payment'
facts.quote: After filling the first page, the applicant has to click on "Make Payment" to make payment of the prescribed fee.

summary: Turn facts (Central-only portal, Rs 10 fee, BPL exemption, Submit Request / Make Payment) confirmed on rtionline.gov.in and the RTI Rules 2012.
